When assessing classification models, accuracy alone isn’t enough—it’s equally important to check how well the predicted probabilities reflect true event likelihoods. A well-calibrated model provides probabilities that can be trusted for decision-making.

This post shows how to extract predicted probabilities from common machine learning and deep learning packages in R and Python.


::: panel-tabset
### R packages

## 🔍 Predicted Probability Extraction in R

| Package | Function |
|---------|----------|
| [glm](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/stats/html/glm.html) | `predict(model, newdata, type = "response")` |
| [randomForest](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/randomForest/randomForest.pdf) | `predict(model, newdata, type = "prob")` |
| [caret](https://topepo.github.io/caret/predictors.html) | `predict(model, newdata, type = "prob")` |
| [xgboost](https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/R-package/predict.html) | `predict(model, newdata)` |
| [lightgbm](https://lightgbm.readthedocs.io/en/latest/R/reference/predict.html) | `predict(model, newdata)` |
| [nnet](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/nnet/html/nnet.html) | `predict(model, newdata, type = "raw")` |
| [mlr3](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/) | `predict(model, newdata)$prob` |
| [tidymodels](https://www.tidymodels.org/start/models/) | `predict(model, new_data, type = "prob")` |
| [e1071](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/e1071/e1071.pdf) (SVM) | `attr(predict(...), "probabilities")` |


### Python packages

## 🔍 Predicted Probability Extraction in Python 

| Package | Function |
|---------|----------|
| [scikit-learn](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.base.ClassifierMixin.html#sklearn.base.ClassifierMixin.predict_proba) | `model.predict_proba(X)` |
| [xgboost](https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/python/python_api.html#xgboost.XGBClassifier.predict) | `model.predict(X)` |
| [lightgbm](https://lightgbm.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pythonapi/lightgbm.LGBMClassifier.html#lightgbm.LGBMClassifier.predict) | `model.predict(X)` |
| [catboost](https://catboost.ai/en/docs/concepts/python-reference_catboostclassifier_predict_proba) | `model.predict_proba(X)` |
| [keras](https://keras.io/api/models/model_training_apis/#predict-method) | `model.predict(X)` |
| [PyTorch](https://pytorch.org/) | `torch.sigmoid(model(X))` |

:::
